items.title: Robinhood expands AI agentic trading with automation and 24/7 cycle
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down Robinhood's (HOOD) unveiling of its AI agentic trading features, including automated strategies and 24-hour markets, and assess whether these are safe spaces for unaccredited investors.

items.title: Robinhood Gives Retail Traders Institutional Tools With AI Trading Bots
items.summary: Robinhood stock surges after announcing plans to launch 24/7 AI trading agents for retail customers, providing institutional resources.

items.title: Bitcoin Rises on Cooler-Than-Expected Inflation Data
items.summary: Bitcoin added 1.4% over the last 24 hours to $85,380 on Tuesday, according to CoinDesk.  The cryptocurrency is down 2.5% this year, but is up 45% this quarter, pacing its best quarterly performance since 2024, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  The personal consumption expenditures, or PCE, price index reached 3.4% year over year in August, below consensus projections to remain at 3.7%.

items.title: Robinhood to Provide Easier Access to AI Agents. Plus, Weekend Trading Is Coming.
items.summary: The brokerage firm is seeking to win more business from customers via an expanded suite of products and tools, including an easier interface for using artificial intelligence to execute trading strategies.

items.title: Kroger Boots Red Bull in High-Stakes Push for Everyday Low Prices
items.summary: Kroger  is playing hardball in its intensified pursuit of low prices, acting more like  Walmart  than a typical supermarket chain, Sarah Nassauer and Patrick Thomas report for The Wall Street Journal.  The grocer halted Red Bull orders around the beginning of August after the brand sought to raise its prices while offering a cheaper deal to a rival.  Red Bull displays are now gone from Kroger locations, and talks remain at a standstill.
